en: Hello! Welcome to Medicaps University Admissions. How can I help you today?
Hi there! I'm your Campus Mind assistant. Ask me about admissions, courses, or placements!
hi: Hello bhai! Medicaps University me tumhara swagat hai. Aaj main tumhari kya madad kar sakta hu?
Hi! Main tumhara Campus Mind assistant hu. Admission, fees, ya placement ke baare me kuch bhi pucho!

en: You're very welcome! 😊 I'm glad I could help. Best of luck with your Medicaps journey. Let me know if you need anything else!
My pleasure! If you ever have more questions about admissions or campus life, I'm always here. Have a great day!
hi: Aree welcome bhai! 😊 Mujhe khushi hai main tumhare kaam aa saka. Medicaps ke liye all the best, aur koi doubt ho toh zaroor poochna!
Mera toh kaam hi yahi hai bhai! Agar admission ya fees ko leke koi aur chinta ho toh wapas message kar dena. Apna dhyan rakhna!

en: Goodbye! Have a fantastic day ahead. Hope to see you on the Medicaps campus soon! 👋
Take care! Feel free to come back whenever you have more questions. Bye!
hi: Bye bhai! Apna dhyan rakhna. Umeed hai jaldi hi tumhe Medicaps campus me dekhunga! 👋
Chalta hu bhai! Admission ke time koi help chahiye ho toh wapas aa jana. Take care!

en:
📋 **Admission Process (2024-25):**
1. Apply for MU-SAT on the official website.
2. Appear for the online exam.
3. Selection is based on MU-SAT scores and merit.
4. Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification.
hi:
📋 **Admission Process:**
Bhai, Medicaps me admission ka main rasta **MU-SAT** exam hai.
1. Pehle website pe jaake MU-SAT ka form bharo.
2. Online exam do (June-August me).
3. Tumhare marks ke basis pe merit list banegi.
4. Uske baad document verification aur counseling hogi.

en:
✅ **Eligibility Criteria:**
• **B.Tech:** 10+2 with Physics & Maths (min 45% for Gen, 40% for reserved).
• **BCA/BBA:** 10+2 in any stream.
• **MBA/MCA:** Graduation with min 50% marks.
hi:
✅ **Eligibility Criteria:**
• **B.Tech:** 12th me Physics aur Maths compulsory hain (General ke liye 45%, reserved ke liye 40%).
• **BCA/BBA:** 12th pass hona chahiye kisi bhi stream se.
• **MBA/MCA:** Graduation me kam se kam 50% marks zaroori hain.

en:
🎓 **Courses Offered at Medicaps:**
• **Engineering:** B.Tech (CSE, AI, Data Science, ECE, ME, CE, Robotics).
• **Management:** BBA & MBA.
• **Computer Applications:** BCA & MCA.
• **Science & Pharma:** B.Sc (Hons), B.Pharm, M.Pharm.
• **Law:** BBA LLB (Hons).
hi:

Yaha options ki kami nahi hai bhai:

• **Management:** BBA aur MBA.

Batao kis branch ki fees janni hai?

en:
💰 **Annual Fee Estimates:**
• **B.Tech (CSE/IT):** ₹2.30L - ₹3.25L
• **B.Tech (Other):** ₹1.50L - ₹2.00L
• **BBA/BCA:** ₹1.00L - ₹1.50L
• **MBA/MCA:** ₹1.30L - ₹1.65L
Scholarships are available via MU-SAT to reduce these costs.
hi:
💰 **Fees ki Details (Per Year Approx):**
• **B.Tech (CSE/IT):** ₹2.30 Lakh se ₹3.25 Lakh tak.
• **B.Tech (Core branches):** ₹1.50 Lakh se ₹2.00 Lakh.
• **BBA/BCA:** ₹1.00 Lakh se ₹1.50 Lakh.
• **MBA/MCA:** ₹1.30 Lakh se ₹1.65 Lakh.
Bhai, scholarship se ye fees kaafi kam ho sakti hai!

en:
🏠 **Hostel Details:**
• **Non-AC:** ₹90,000/year
• **AC Room:** ₹1,27,500/year
• **Mess Fees:** ₹40,000 (includes all meals).
Facilities include Wi-Fi, Gym, Sports, and 24/7 security.
hi:
🏠 **Hostel ki Details:**
Campus me boys aur girls ke separate hostels hain:
• **Non-AC Room:** ₹90,000 saal ka.
• **AC Room:** ₹1,27,500 saal ka.
• **Mess ka khana:** ₹40,000 alag se lagenge.

en:
🏛️ **Campus Facilities:**
Central Library (50K+ books), High-tech computer/research labs, Free Wi-Fi, Sports complex (pool, cricket), Medical center, and multiple cafeterias.
hi:
🏛️ **Campus Facilities:**
Bhai campus me sab suvidha hai:
50,000+ books wali library, latest labs, pure campus me free Wi-Fi, sports ground, swimming pool, aur badiya canteen.

en:
🏆 **Scholarships:**
• **MU-SAT Merit:** Up to 100% tuition fee waiver for top rankers.
• **Board Merit:** Discounts for state/district toppers.
• **Income-based:** Aid for families with income < ₹2L (with 80%+ marks).
hi:
🏆 **Scholarships:**
Bhai, paise bachane ke kai raste hain:
• **MU-SAT rank:** 10% se 100% tak fees maaf ho sakti hai.
• **12th marks:** Agar tum topper ho toh special discount milega.
• **Income:** Garib baccho (BPL card) ke liye bhi financial aid milti hai.

en:
📝 **Entrance Exam (MU-SAT):**
Required for most UG/PG courses for admission and scholarships. It's an online exam covering Aptitude, Verbal, and Domain subjects (Physics/Maths/etc).
hi:
📝 **Entrance Exam (MU-SAT):**
Bhai, admission aur scholarship ke liye MU-SAT test dena padta hai. Ye online hota hai jisme Aptitude, English aur 12th ke subjects aate hain.

en:
🏫 **About Medicaps University:**
Established in 2000, it's a NAAC A+ accredited university with 10,000+ students, 800+ faculty, and 40+ programs.
hi:

Saal 2000 me shuru hua ye college ab ek badi University hai jise NAAC A+ grade mila hai. Yaha 10,000+ students padhte hain aur iska mahaul ekdum badiya hai.
